facilities.label: Main clubhouse roof
facilities.sourceNotes: Visible main roof perimeter, including intersecting north and east wings. Dark grey roof. Eaves and roof displacement are not wall-footprint measurements; heights and pitch unresolved. IMPORTANT: the east entrance porch projects into roof shadow and is omitted from this main-roof ring because its outer edge cannot be confidently isolated. Add that porch as a separate photo-corroborated component; the yellow existing-model east bump is context only. R02 is the separate west terrace-side porch, not the eastern entrance.

facilities.label: Clubhouse west attached porch roof
facilities.sourceNotes: Small attached west-facing roof by terrace; exact function and wall base unknown.

facilities.label: Eastern campus accommodation block candidate
facilities.sourceNotes: Northernmost of three smaller connected dark-roof blocks south of clubhouse. Photo/site evidence needed to assign hotel room wings definitively.

facilities.label: Middle campus accommodation block candidate
facilities.sourceNotes: Middle dark-roof block with small connection at southwest edge. Roof-edge ring includes connection visible from above.

facilities.sourceNotes: Southern block west of pool; roof includes visible lower west annex. Pool-side function must be matched against exterior photos.

facilities.label: Translucent rectangular roof east of middle block
facilities.sourceNotes: Light/translucent roof with cross ribs. Could be enclosure or conservatory; orthophoto alone does not identify function.

facilities.label: Small polygonal garden roof
facilities.sourceNotes: Small polygonal gazebo-like roof east of pool. Tree/shadow overlap limits exact corner count.

facilities.sourceNotes: Clearly visible substantial dark roof absent from current infrastructure model. Do not assign hotel, maintenance or padel use from proximity alone.

facilities.label: Western complex southern rectangular roof
facilities.sourceNotes: Short east-west rectangular roof south of western complex. Function and height unknown.

facilities.label: Outdoor pool water surface
facilities.sourceNotes: Pool water edge only, excluding white deck/surround and steps; permanent pool dimension is approximate.

facilities.label: Blue outdoor padel playing enclosure
facilities.sourceNotes: Visible blue playing enclosure, excluding cast fence shadows and surrounding paths. Fence/glass height not determined.

facilities.label: Northwest campus parking apron
facilities.sourceNotes: Gravel/asphalt parking apron inferred from visible material boundary; cars and vegetation obscure edges.

facilities.label: Central north-south parking apron
facilities.sourceNotes: Parking strip east of clubhouse and west of planted divider. Material edge approximate under parked cars.

facilities.label: Eastern parking apron
facilities.sourceNotes: Eastern parking strip and southern turning connection. Far eastern bays partially limited by panel edge.

facilities.label: Clubhouse entrance circular island
facilities.sourceNotes: Oval/circular paved or planted entrance feature in front of clubhouse. Interior sculpture/flag/details require exterior references.

facilities.label: Curved range hitting-mat apron
facilities.sourceNotes: Visible paved curved mat apron excluding roofed range-end building. Mat positions and flagpoles should be added individually from this native panel; do not infer count from shadows.

provenance.buildingIdentityContract: Numeric pack indices are guarded by corresponding exact decoded rings. Missing source IDs are empty arrays, never undefined IDs.
provenance.projection: Per-vertex PROJ EPSG:3006 to WGS84, then exact published GPK1 local frame. Normals use inverse-transpose of the local full horizontal Jacobian.
provenance.groundContactContract: Only six explicitly inspected draped paving source objects have groundContact=true. Raised terraces, stairs, buildings, furnishings, island edging, mats and poles are excluded. This bake does not alter source paving elevations.
provenance.heightContract: Geometry Y is absolute RH2000. The runtime loader applies its chosen vertical datum offset; no legacy height bias is baked.
